author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
I put three of the best-selling electric pressure washers head-to-head: the affordable Sun Joe SPX3000, the popular Greenworks Pro 3000 GPW3000 and the DeWalt Suitcase 2600 PSI 
I put each pressure washer through real life tests on dirty patio stones, a driveway, wood fencing and car panels to compare cleaning power, PSI, GPM, spray tips, ease of use and setup, storage, and overall value. If you’re trying to find the best pressure washer for homeowners or wondering how much PSI you actually need for cleaning a driveway, fence, patio or car, the full comparison will help you choose the right machine.
